# 013-flight

**Provider.** ITA Airways, direct booking confirmation in Italian.

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts, no attachment. Reference bar labelled "Codice di prenotazione (PNR)", one flight card, a passenger table with seats and ticket numbers, a payment summary, a change and cancellation paragraph, check-in advice and two upsell blocks.

**Why.** A domestic Italian flight for two adults. ITA Airways flies under the IATA code AZ, so the carrier name and the flight-number prefix differ. Italian date and money formats (`sabato 24 aprile 2027`, `194,94 €` with the symbol after the amount), the airport printed in Italian (`Roma Fiumicino`) while the city is normalised to Rome, ticket numbers and a Volare loyalty number near the reference, and seat selection shown as "incluso" instead of an amount. The cancellation terms are one prose paragraph rather than labelled lines.
